content.text:
Fixed in [formats/components/src/components/tooltip/tooltip.css](formats/components/src/components/tooltip/tooltip.css):

- The bubble centered with `inset-inline-start: 50%` + `transform: translateX(-50%)`. In RTL, `inset-inline-start` resolves to `right`, so the physical `translateX(-50%)` pushed the bubble further away instead of back toward center. Now it uses physical `left: 50%`, which centers correctly in both directions.
- `-placement-start`/`-placement-end` used physical margins for the gap, which landed on the wrong side in RTL; they're now `margin-inline-end` / `margin-inline-start`.

Regenerated `src/generated/component-styles.ts`, tests pass, and added a changeset.
